text: The Udinese front brand 'Io sono Friuli Venezia Giulia' is bought by the Friuli Venezia Giulia regional government through PromoTurismoFVG, the region's public tourism agency, per the club's own announcement of the renewal to 2028/29.

source.name: Udinese Calcio - Io sono Friuli Venezia Giulia renews Udinese shirt sponsorship deal until 2028/29
source.quote: The Friuli Venezia Giulia Region, through PromoTurismoFVG, the organisation that deals with the promotion of tourism in the area, and Udinese Calcio S.p.A. have signed a new sponsorship agreement
